last30DaysByDefaultUnknownCostsRequire: Last 30 days by default. Unknown costs require reconciliation; they are not zero. Payments and point consumption are separate measures. Wallet balances and open reviews are current totals.
deepseekFirstGlmOnFailureApplicationFilt: DeepSeek first; GLM on failure. Application filtering remains active during gateway sync failures. An unavailable gateway is never bypassed.
amountsRetainTheirOriginalPrecisionNullM: Amounts retain their original precision; null means unknown or not applicable.
pointsOnlyNoCashRefundsRefundsRequireAn: Points only; no cash refunds. Refunds require an original debit. Expired monthly points remain expired.
thisRecordsTheResolutionCompletePointAdj: This records the resolution. Complete point adjustments first, then attach the ledger ID.
